I delete your message right away and keep the token encrypted. The team's bank account must already be linked in SePay.

ask.income: ➕ Record other income: prizes, sponsors, the balance from before the bot… Reply to this message as: amount note [date] • Amount: 300000, 300k, 1.5m, 1tr5, 5M… (/money) • Note: anything • Date (optional), at the end: 15/10/2026, 15-10-2026, 15/10/26, 15-10-26; 15/10 = this year. No date = now. It can't be in the future. Examples: 2m Championship prize 1.5m Opening balance 31/10/2026
ask.expense: ➖ Record a team expense. Reply to this message as: amount note [date] • Amount: 300000, 300k, 1.5m, 1tr5, 5M… (/money) • Note: anything • Date (optional), at the end: 15/10/2026, 15-10-2026, 15/10/26, 15-10-26; 15/10 = this year. No date = now. It can't be in the future. Examples: 500k Pitch rental 300k New balls 15-10-2026 Have a receipt photo? Send it with the caption /expense 500k Pitch rental.
err.money_format: ⚠️ Not quite: start with the amount, then the note.
money.help: 💰 Writing amounts 450000 · 450.000 · 450,000đ → 450,000đ 450k → 450,000đ (k = thousand) 1tr · 1m · 1M → 1,000,000đ (tr / m = million) 1.5tr · 1,5tr · 1tr5 · 1.5M → 1,500,000đ 2tr250 → 2,250,000đ 5M → 5,000,000đ Upper or lower case both work. 📅 Writing dates (optional, at the end) 15/10/2026 · 15-10-2026 · 15/10/26 · 15-10-26 15/10 · 15-10 → this year No date → now. It can't be in the future. Examples /expense 450k Pitch 15/10 /income 1tr5 Sponsor /income 5M Opening balance 31-10-26
